title: Hockey Scoreboard Plugin Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the Hockey Scoreboard plugin - displays live, recent, and upcoming NHL and NCAA Hockey games

scroll_card.title: Scroll & Vegas Card Layout
scroll_card.description: Layout of the game cards built for scroll and Vegas modes. The full-screen scoreboard is drawn separately and is not affected by these settings.

upcoming_center.title: Middle of an Upcoming Card
upcoming_center.description: What to show between the two logos before a game starts. Upcoming games never show a score, since the game has not been played.

vs_text.title: Matchup Separator
vs_text.description: Text drawn between the two teams, e.g. VS, @, at, v. The away team is always on the left and the home team on the right, so "at" and "@" read correctly as "away at home". Leave blank to draw nothing.

date_format.title: Date Format
date_format.description: How to write the date: abbrev "Sep 19", numeric "9/19", day_first "19 Sep", numeric_day_first "19/9", weekday "Fri Sep 19".

show_date.title: Show Date
show_date.description: Draw the date on upcoming cards.

show_time.title: Show Time
show_time.description: Draw the start time on upcoming cards.

swap_date_time.title: Swap Date and Time
swap_date_time.description: Put the date on top and the time along the bottom instead of the default.

center_gap.title: Center Gap
center_gap.description: Pixels kept clear down the middle so the score or VS is not drawn over the team logos. Leave unset to scale with the card width. 0 restores the old edge-to-edge logos.

center_gap_ratio.title: Center Gap Ratio
center_gap_ratio.description: Fraction of card width used for the centre gap when it is not pinned.

center_gap_min.title: Center Gap Minimum
center_gap_min.description: Lower bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

center_gap_max.title: Center Gap Maximum
center_gap_max.description: Upper bound in pixels for the scaled centre gap.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the hockey scoreboard plugin

timezone.description: IANA timezone used to display event start times (e.g. America/Chicago). Leave blank to follow the LEDMatrix global timezone, or the system timezone if none is set.

defaults.description: Default settings that can be inherited by leagues (can be overridden per league)

display_duration.description: Default duration in seconds to display each game

show_records.description: Default setting to show team records (wins-losses)

show_ranking.description: Default setting to show team rankings (when available)

show_odds.description: Default setting to show betting odds for games

show_shots_on_goal.description: Default setting to display shots on goal statistics during games

show_powerplay.description: Default setting to highlight powerplay situations

update_interval_seconds.description: Default base update interval in seconds for fetching game data

season_cache_duration_seconds.description: How long to cache season data (seconds)

display_modes.title: Display Modes
display_modes.description: Control which game types to show and how they are displayed

live_display_mode.description: Display mode for live games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

recent_display_mode.description: Display mode for recent games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

upcoming_display_mode.description: Display mode for upcoming games: 'switch' shows one game at a time, 'scroll' scrolls all games horizontally

scroll_settings.title: Scroll Settings
scroll_settings.description: Settings for scroll display mode (when display mode is set to 'scroll')

scroll_speed.description: Scroll speed in pixels per second (default: 50). Higher values scroll faster.

scroll_delay.description: Delay between scroll frames in seconds (default: 0.01 = 100 FPS). Lower values = smoother scrolling.

gap_between_games.description: Gap in pixels between game cards when scrolling

show_league_separators.description: Show league icons (NHL shield, NCAA logos) between different leagues

dynamic_duration.description: Automatically calculate display duration based on content width

game_card_width.description: Width of each game card in scroll mode (pixels). Default 128. Set lower on multi-panel chains to show more games simultaneously.

exclude_teams.description: NHL team abbreviations to always hide from live rotation and recent/final scores (e.g. to avoid spoilers when watching delayed). Takes precedence over favorite_teams and show_all_live.

favorite_teams_only.description: Only show NHL games with favorite teams

show_all_live.description: Show all live NHL games, not just favorites

favorite_live_boost.description: How many turns your favorite team's live NHL game gets in the rotation for every 1 turn other live games get. Your favorite's game is also always queued first whenever the live rotation refreshes. Set to 1 for even rotation.

recent_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

upcoming_games_to_show.description: With favorites: N games per favorite team. Without favorites: N total games sorted by time.

base.description: Base update interval for NHL data

live.description: Update interval for live NHL games

recent.description: Update interval for recent NHL games

upcoming.description: Update interval for upcoming NHL games

odds.description: Update interval for NHL betting odds data

display_durations.description: How long to display games on screen (in seconds)

base.description: Base display duration for NHL games

live.description: Display duration for live NHL games (games with a favorite team when a non-favorite duration is set)

non_favorite_live.description: Display duration for live NHL games with NO favorite team. Only applies when favorite teams are set AND non-favorite live games are shown ('show_favorite_teams_only' off, or 'show_all_live' on). 0 (default) = use the live duration for every game (no change).

recent.description: Display duration for recent NHL games

upcoming.description: Display duration for upcoming NHL games

display_options.description: What information to display on the scoreboard

show_odds.description: Show betting odds for NHL games

show_shots_on_goal.description: Display shots on goal statistics for NHL games

show_powerplay.description: Highlight powerplay situations for NHL games

mode_durations.title: Mode-Level Durations
mode_durations.description: Control total duration for each mode type for NHL. If not set, uses dynamic calculation (total_games × per_game_duration).

recent_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Recent mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (uses dynamic calculation). Set to null to use dynamic calculation. When mode cycles back, continues from last game shown (no repetition).

upcoming_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Upcoming mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (uses dynamic calculation). Set to null to use dynamic calculation. When mode cycles back, continues from last game shown (no repetition).

live_mode_duration.description: Total duration in seconds for Live mode before rotating to next mode. Default: null (uses dynamic calculation). Set to null to use dynamic calculation. When mode cycles back, continues from last game shown (no repetition).

live_priority.description: Prioritize live NHL games over scheduled games

dynamic_duration.description: Dynamic duration settings - automatically adjust display time based on content

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NHL games

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration in seconds when dynamic duration is enabled

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NHL live games

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration for NHL live games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NHL recent games

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration for NHL recent games

enabled.description: Enable dynamic duration for NHL upcoming games

max_duration_seconds.description: Maximum duration for NHL upcoming games

customization.title: Display Customization
customization.description: Customize fonts for different text elements on the scoreboard

score_text.title: Game Score
score_text.description: Font settings for the game score display

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use for scores (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the score text on scroll/Vegas cards.

period_text.title: Period/Clock
period_text.description: Font settings for period, clock, and time remaining text

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the period text on scroll/Vegas cards.

team_name.title: Team Names
team_name.description: Font settings for team name abbreviations

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the team name on scroll/Vegas cards.

status_text.title: Status Messages
status_text.description: Font settings for status text (e.g., 'Next Game', 'Final')

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the status text on scroll/Vegas cards.

detail_text.title: Details/Odds
detail_text.description: Font settings for odds and other detail information

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the detail text on scroll/Vegas cards.

font.title: Font Family
font.description: Select the font to use (only TTF fonts supported)

text_color.title: Text Color
text_color.description: Colour [R, G, B] for the rank text on scroll/Vegas cards.

layout.title: Layout Positioning
layout.description: Adjust X,Y coordinate offsets for elements. Values are relative to default positions. Use negative values to move left/up, positive to move right/down.

away_x_offset.description: Away team record horizontal offset from left (default: 0)

home_x_offset.description: Home team record horizontal offset from right (default: 0)

favorite_result_colors.title: Favorite Team Result Colors
favorite_result_colors.description: Color the final score of a recent game by how your favorite team did. Most useful in scroll and Vegas modes, where the same matchup can go past several times and the logos alone do not tell you who won.

enabled.title: Color Scores by Result
enabled.description: Show the final score in green when your favorite team won and red when it lost. Games without exactly one favorite team - neither side, or both - keep the normal score color.

win_color.title: Win Color
win_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when your favorite team won

loss_color.title: Loss Color
loss_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when your favorite team lost

tie_color.title: Tie Color
tie_color.description: Score color [R, G, B] when the game ended level

schedule_lookback_days.title: Schedule lookback (days)
schedule_lookback_days.description: How far back to fetch games for the Recent screen. Raise it if finished games disappear sooner than you want.

schedule_lookahead_days.title: Schedule lookahead (days)
schedule_lookahead_days.description: How far ahead to fetch games for the Upcoming screen. Raise it for a league that plays weekly: a fixture just beyond this horizon is not fetched at all, so it never reaches the board even though the date is known.

no_data_interval_seconds.title: Idle live-check interval (seconds)
no_data_interval_seconds.description: How long to wait between checks for live games when there are none. Backs off further the longer nothing is found, up to the cap below.

live_idle_max_interval_seconds.title: Maximum idle live-check interval (seconds)
live_idle_max_interval_seconds.description: Ceiling for the back-off above. Raise it to poll an out-of-season league even less; lower it to notice the first game after a quiet spell sooner.
